links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated runs on diabetes questions
links.effect: High response reproducibility (96.7%) across repeated runs on 30 diabetes questions, with 80% accuracy.
links.quote: Claude Opus 4 achieved 80% accuracy in general diabetes knowledge, with high response reproducibility (96.7%), indicating baseline rather than clinically adequate performance.

links.outcome: Accuracy of clinical knowledge against ADA guidelines graded by endocrinologists
links.effect: 80% accuracy in general diabetes knowledge; mean expert rating of 4.4/7 on clinical cases, described as moderate utility.
links.quote: Clinical case evaluations showed moderate utility (mean expert rating = 4.4/7), while emotional-support assessments yielded high scores for empathy (6.2/7) and appropriateness (6.0/7).

unlisted_practices: Mixed expert-patient panels for evaluating LLM outputs
Person-centered metrics beyond numerical accuracy for LLM evaluation

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of Claude Opus 4 on simulated diabetes cases and questions assessed by expert clinicians, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
